the combination of robust preprocessing, LTP based local texture representations, distance transform matching, and Kernel PCA feature extraction leads to state of the art face recognition accuracy under difficult lighting conditions.

the proposed preprocessing chain is the best method for removing lighting variation while preserving the most useful appearance information, that LTP is the most discriminant local texture descriptor, and that combining LTP and Gabor based features in a distance transform based matching framework provides state of the ar t face recognition performance.
